descriptions.private commercial price: Nonpublic agreed purchase price or individual sale quote. Include the value and currency; exclude product unit. Exclude published prices.
descriptions.internal negotiation limit: Our undisclosed maximum purchase price, minimum sale price or allowed discount ceiling. Include the numeric value and its currency or percent.
descriptions.private immediate discount: Agreed nonpublic reduction of the current invoice. Include its amount or rate and the written application condition. Exclude public promotions and negotiating limits.
descriptions.private retrospective rebate: Nonpublic reward or refund after purchases or a reporting period. Include the complete formula: amount or rate, basis, threshold and period. Exclude public programs.
descriptions.private payment schedule: Individually agreed nonpublic payment schedule. Include all written installments, deadlines and trigger events. Exclude published standard payment terms.
descriptions.internal deal profitability: Internal margin or gross profit for a particular deal. Include its percentage or monetary value and written percentage base. Exclude published financial reports.
